title: The App table and .harness/config.json: an App, a model and an effort per Stage row
description:
Per the map tickets 'Models per Stage' (harness-0sx.6), 'Prototype: the /config modal' (harness-0sx.9, ROWS as revised) and 'Apps per Stage' (harness-0sx.14). Research: research/stage-models (docs/research/stage-models.md), research/agent-clis (docs/research/agent-clis.md).

The App table: compiled in, one row per App: herdr kind and binary, homepage, the unattended args for a pane Stage (in the worktree; the Review in the Run directory), the model and effort arg forms, the Delegate-skill mention form, the trust reader. This Ticket fills the claude and codex rows from today's Stage table, attempt() args and trusts(): claude --permission-mode auto --add-dir <Run directory> (Implement: plan mode and its --settings); codex in the Run directory with --sandbox workspace-write for the Review, and for a worktree Stage the unattended args from the research, with network for Fix and Address, which push and open PRs. Fields only later Tickets use (limit patterns, resume argv, side commands, model-list command) arrive with them.

The Stage table keeps name, skill and timeout; the App comes from the config. Rows in .harness/config.json (per checkout, under the gitignored .harness/): Implement, Review, Review if limited (starts as none), Moderator, Debate side A (also runs the ponytail audit), Debate side B, Fix, Address; each an App, a model and an effort. Every row starts at default: today's App for that Stage (claude, but codex for the Review and side B), model default and effort default, which pass no flag, so nothing changes until you pick. A missing or partial file reads as defaults; an unreadable one refuses a run with a notice naming the file. No prompt at /start-epic.

Flags: claude panes --model <m> / --effort <e>; codex panes -m <m> / -c model_reasoning_effort=<e>, added to attempt()'s agent args. The file is read when a Stage starts: Stages that start after a change use it, running ones keep theirs. A Review on claude runs in the Run directory with --add-dir <worktree> (Ticket 11 adds its guard). Implement on another App than claude is refused where the config is read ('Implement off claude needs the two-step Plan') until Ticket 12. The Debate's side commands stay in stage-moderate until Ticket 11. RECENT's started line names the model and effort when set: 'implement started: claude opus/high <where>'.

The reasoning behind each decision is on the map's closed tickets: bd show harness-0sx.<n> --json --include-comments. Research notes and prototypes live on local branches: git show research/<name>:docs/research/<file>.md, git show prototype/<name>:<path>. Vocabulary: CONTEXT.md. Decisions: docs/adr/. Rust; crates limited to serde, serde_json, regex, chrono, crossterm, ratatui and ureq, anything else needs a ticket.
acceptance_criteria: Fake world: with no config.json every argv is today's (the existing tests pass unchanged); a row's model and effort add the right flags on claude and on codex; a Review on claude starts in the Run directory with --add-dir <worktree>; the started line names model and effort; config.json changed between two Stages reaches the second; an unreadable config.json refuses the run with a notice; Implement on codex is refused; trust is read through the row's App.
